conversion_details: Official PNG extracted without modification; its complete 716x716 canvas (including original clearspace) was uniformly resized to 512x512.

Black artwork unchanged; transparency composited on plain white to keep the official black mark readable in both light and dark marketplace tiles. No redraw, crop, rotation, recolor, effects, or extra marks.
ImageMagick: magick OAI_OpenAI-Blossom_Black.png -resize 512x512 -background white -alpha remove -alpha off icon.png

usage_notes: Use Blossom only as the provider icon next to the OpenAI Tools product name in the extension listing. Do not make it Flow Steward primary branding.
Retain official full-canvas spacing. Do not combine with OpenAI wordmark into a new lockup.
No legal acceptance checkbox was clicked. The public CDN archive was downloaded directly.
visual_inspection: Source and final PNG inspected with view_image; final artwork centered and unclipped with official clearspace.
